# Vidsc Flyleaf source integration

Upstream: https://github.com/SuRGeoNix/Flyleaf, exact commit `0f061769c47d50dfdae5c667435bf6548a0dc121` (the repository commit recorded in FlyleafLib 3.11.11 NuGet metadata). Imported with `git archive` limited to FlyleafLib, LICENSE.txt and its package icon; upstream applications and history excluded. Upstream project declares 3.11.10 despite the published 3.11.11 package recording this commit.

License: LGPL-3.0-or-later; original LICENSE.txt and all source notices retained. Ship the license and corresponding modified source with redistributions according to its terms.

The local project targets net10.0-windows, Version 3.11.11, informational version `3.11.11+vidsc.hook.1`. All upstream dependency versions remain exact, including Flyleaf.FFmpeg.Bindings 9.0.2 and Vortice 3.8.3. Empty local props isolate upstream nullable/compiler and package version policy from the application. Native playback libraries remain the separately pinned playback ABI set; CLI FFmpeg is not interchangeable.

Changes are limited to scalar raw decoded-frame metadata, typed unproven presentation evidence, source/decode/operation epochs, scheduling token capture, render/backbuffer submission association, and raw-HRESULT DXGI confirmation with a bounded 256-entry map and independent paused-frame polling. Notifications are immutable and delivered asynchronously on a single owned worker, outside native/renderer locks. No GPU surface is retained by the tracker. The public entry point is `Player.Presentation`; declaration and callback contracts are in `MediaFramework/MediaRenderer/PresentationTracker.cs`.

`IsProven` deliberately remains false. `NextRawPts` is unknown until a contiguous frame oracle is independently established; neither nominal FPS nor raw duration establishes EOF presentation end. Missing source PTS or exact container epoch is preserved as null. PTS and best-effort are captured before Flyleaf normalization, on all three receive paths. Decoder setup activates staged source generation; seek requests and step render scheduling retain their specific operation context. Decoder work with a stale token is rejected. A fresh seek or explicit Pause→Play scheduling barrier can re-arm the current presentation intent; callbacks never retag already scheduled work. Native present-ID baselines survive application operation changes and ResizeBuffers, while a recreated native swapchain starts a new count epoch.

Build: `dotnet build third_party/FlyleafLib/FlyleafLib/FlyleafLib.csproj -c Release -m:1 --disable-build-servers`. Application project references use this source tree. The native prerequisite experiment and remaining acceptance requirements are recorded in `docs/validation/2026-10-14-m1-hook-experiment.md` and the hook decision. No production exact-edit eligibility is established by this integration alone.

Modified upstream files: FlyleafLib.csproj; MediaFramework/MediaDecoder/VideoDecoder.cs; MediaFramework/MediaFrame/VideoFrame.cs; MediaFramework/MediaRenderer/Renderer.Device.cs, Renderer.Present.cs and SwapChain.cs; MediaPlayer/Player.cs, Player.Playback.cs, Player.Extra.cs, Player.Screamers.cs and Player.Screamers.VASD.cs. Added PresentationTracker.cs and Properties/VidscTests.cs (test access only). Configuration and license/icon files are tracked alongside the source. Build outputs are ignored. The pristine source archive SHA256 is recorded in the diagnostic vendor-foundation/build-identity.json; production build identity is generated from tracked source hashes by the release workflow.

Validation to date: isolated vendor compiles; standalone production-source probe runs actual playback and a final paused seek and confirms the latter through independent polling without another Present (`artifacts/experiments/m1-hook/production-native.jsonl`, exit 0). Focused actual-tracker regressions cover operation baseline, uint wrap, disjoint after confirmation, swapchain reset/resize, source replacement and final paused timeout. Application/visible fixture acceptance is recorded separately by the integration owner. These checks do not prove presentation end or exact edit eligibility.

Paused recovery API: `Player.TryRefreshPresentation(intent)` schedules a fresh render of the owned cached same-source frame only after native seek/play ownership is drained. It preserves original raw metadata, validates the frozen current operation and reports scheduling only. `PresentationSeekIdle` is an asynchronous advisory wakeup after seek cleanup, enabling a pending recovery attempt without polling or sleeping. It is never presentation evidence. Reset/resize clears the old backbuffer identity before any subsequent native submit.
